name: modemax
description: Shape work with the user into tickets, then build each ticket with deliberate subagents, simple code, and verified evidence. pstack's way of building (Lauren Tan, via the pstack-claude port) merged with Matt Pocock's grilling, specs, and tickets. Codex build: tool names resolve via skills/modemax/references/codex-tools.md.

interface.shortDescription: Shape work into tickets, then build and verify each one
interface.longDescription: modemax shapes work with you (grilling, glossary and ADRs, specs, tracer-bullet tickets on the issue tracker), then builds each ticket through playbooks with parallel design exploration (architect/arena), adversarial review (interrogate), test-first seams, and verified delivery as a PR that closes the ticket.
defaultPrompt: Grill me on this feature, then write the spec and tickets.
